narratives.narrative: Revenue fell short of budget by $2.35M due to delayed product launch impacting Q3 sales. Management inquiry MGT-INQ-2024-08-001 confirms attribution with VP Operations John Doe citing supply chain disruptions.
narratives.business_driver: Delayed product launch caused a 15% reduction in forecasted sales volume (7,500 units vs 8,850 forecast units)
narratives.management_response: John Doe (VP Operations): Supply chain disruptions delayed product availability, reducing sales volume by 15%
supporting_evidence: PRD-2024-08-001: Product launch timeline showing delayed release
OPS-2024-08-002: Supply chain report detailing shipment delays
CRM-2024-08-003: Sales system showing reduced order volumes
narratives.analytical_procedures: Sales volume reduction aligns with historical trends during product delays (-15% average impact)
narratives.risk_assessment: Moderate risk - dependent on resolution of supply chain issues

narratives.narrative: Cost of goods sold exceeded budget by $1.25M due to increased raw material prices. Management inquiry MGT-INQ-2024-08-002 confirms attribution with CFO Jane Smith citing 18% price hike in key materials.
narratives.business_driver: Raw material cost increased by 18% (average price per unit $12.50 vs $10.60 budgeted)
narratives.management_response: Jane Smith (CFO): Raw material price hikes increased COGS by $1.25M
supporting_evidence: FIN-2024-08-004: Procurement report showing material price increases
MKT-2024-08-005: Market intelligence report validating price hikes
OPS-2024-08-006: Supplier invoices confirming higher costs
narratives.analytical_procedures: Material cost increase aligns with industry trends during Q3 (+15-20%)
narratives.risk_assessment: Low risk - corroborated by external market intelligence and supplier invoices
